title: chore: remove unused Inception secret
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Removes `INCEPTION_API_KEY` from encrypted dev, staging, and production configuration.
- Removes the unused Worker binding, text environment synchronization, and secret-push requirement.
- Keeps Mercury 2 unchanged on its pinned OpenRouter route; this does not revoke the credential at Inception.

Validation:
- SOPS decrypt validation for all three environment files
- Repository-wide reference check
- Gen typecheck
- 34 focused Gen tests
- Local Gen build without an Inception binding
- Paid production Mercury smoke through OpenRouter (`200`, expected content)

gist.headline: One less secret in the shed
gist.blurb: The unused Inception key has been swept out of the generation worker’s config garden. Mercury 2 keeps taking its usual OpenRouter path, undisturbed.
gist.summary: Removed the unused INCEPTION_API_KEY from Gen dev, staging, and production secrets, Worker bindings, environment sync, and secret-push scripts while Mercury 2 remains pinned to OpenRouter.
gist.impact: Gen deployments and local builds now need one fewer unused binding, with Mercury 2 continuing to return expected production responses through OpenRouter.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy garden-shed cleanup: Polli removes a dusty, unlabeled secret-key jar from a retro terminal shelf while a healthy Mercury 2 route glows on the terminal. Use small code-plants and a clearly intact OpenRouter path to show that the active service remains unchanged.
